payload.text: Pair-universe asset-class classification (docs/CONVENTIONS.md InstrumentClass → registry PairMeta): PairMeta::is_precious_metal is a pure total function of self.instrument — returns true exactly for InstrumentClass::PreciousMetal (the loco-London metal-leg pairs), false for fiat. const fn, no writes/allocation/IO; deterministic. Self-invalidates if the match arm or InstrumentClass variants change (WRITES gate).
